content.question: Why can pre-trained models be adapted to new tasks with relatively little additional training data?
options: They copy the correct answers directly from the training dataset.
They have already learned to recognize patterns and generalize them within the knowledge they were trained on.
They do not need to learn any patterns for the new task.
They automatically create the missing labels for the new task.
content.answer: They have already learned to recognize patterns and generalize them within the knowledge they were trained on.
